name: browser-automation-studio.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of browser-automation-studio's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or unavailable, without estimating.

evidence_sample.description: Failed executions whose screenshots are counted (0..10).

assumptions: the caller treats an unavailable row as unknown, never as zero
executions list is a fleet-wide list ordered newest first
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized beyond evidence_sample rows; readings are count and filter
a row whose sensor has no governed binding is reported unavailable with the reason, not computed by hand
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
no setpoint row is computed by hand from files; a row without a governed sensor reads unavailable with the reason

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason}; one per setpoint row in the improve skill's table order: pass-rate, flake-rate, selector-failure-rate, p95-step-duration, failed-run-evidence, external-friction
signals.readable: count of rows read from a governed binding
signals.unavailable: count of rows not readable in-program

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row
